source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Singleton pattern (PDF 25).

blocks.text: Singleton Design Pattern yeh yaqeeni banane ka tareeqa hai ke program mein koi khaas object ya resource sirf ek baar bane aur jab bhi zaroorat ho usi ko dobara istemal kiya jaye. Ise aise samjhein ke ek khaas kamre ki sirf ek chaabi hai; jo bhi kamre mein jana chahe, sab ko wahi ek chaabi istemal karni hai. Nayi chaabiyan nahi banti, sab ek hi chaabi share karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Software ki koi misal dein jahan kisi cheez ka sirf ek object hona chahiye.
blocks.explanation: Misal: application ki settings (configuration) ka ek hi object, ya database connection sambhalne wala ek hi object, jise program ka har hissa istemal karta hai, har hissa apna naya nahi banata.

items: Singleton: object sirf ek baar banta hai aur sab usi ko share karte hain (ek kamre ki ek chaabi).
